name: single_tool_contract
input: /tool-design Спроектируй описание и JSON-схему одного инструмента для поиска заказа агентом.
expected_behavior: uses tool-design for the individual tool contract
defines inputs, output shape, and recoverable errors

name: ambiguous_tool_input
input: /tool-design Улучши инструмент search без описания его текущих параметров или результатов.
expected_behavior: asks for the current tool contract or labels assumptions
does not invent current parameter names
forbidden_behavior: claims a fabricated schema is the existing contract

name: no_unrequested_server_write
input: /tool-design Оцени, почему агент путает два похожих инструмента в каталоге.
expected_behavior: compares tool triggers and recommends a contract-level change
forbidden_behavior: modifies or deploys an MCP server without a change request

name: custom_server_route
input: /tool-design Собери MCP-сервер для нашего внутреннего workflow, OpenAPI нет.
expected_behavior: recommends mcp-builder for whole-server implementation after explicit tool-design invocation
forbidden_behavior: uses tool-design as a whole-server implementation workflow

name: openapi_server_route
expected_behavior: recommends mcp-server-builder for OpenAPI-first server generation after explicit tool-design invocation
